headline: Toyota Posts Quarterly Profit Surge and Raises Annual Outlook on Strong Hybrid Demand
summary: Toyota Motor reported its first quarterly profit gain in six quarters and raised its annual profit forecast on strong demand for hybrid vehicles, prompting its largest single-day share gain since 1987.
why: Toyota is the world's largest automaker by volume; its financial health serves as a global industry indicator.

impacts.name: Toyota Motor Corporation
impacts.why: Strong quarterly earnings and an upgraded annual forecast triggered a record single-day surge in Toyota's stock.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Toyota stock recorded its biggest single-day surge since 1987 after reporting a quarterly profit recovery and lifting its full-year earnings guidance.
